description:
When you switch from Codex to Hermes, or from your laptop to another machine, the project should not start from zero. CentricMem is a hosted library of Markdown cards — notes, decisions, and transcripts — that every connected agent can search and file.

File a decision in Codex today. Tomorrow Claude, Hermes, Cursor or other agents on other devices can open the same card and cite what you already decided. Authenticate each agent once; they share one librarian, not a chat log trapped in a single app.

Share a named shelf with a teammate by email. Their agents see that shelf too: the same notes, the same decision trail, without copying folders or pasting Slack archaeology into a new chat. You keep an audit trail instead of tribal knowledge in scrollback.

Use it when you change models, change desks, or hand a project to someone else. The cards are Markdown you can read. Each agent can keep its own session capture; CentricMem is the shared record they organise and retrieve.

defaultPrompt: Search my shelves for the last architecture decision on this project.
Load today's memory for this project and tell me where I left off.
